text_visible: 讲义首先回顾了对生成模型的核心需求：能很好地拟合训练数据（乃至其底层分布）、能对新数据x评估其概率密度、能从模型中采样、以及拥有有意义的隐空间表示。
接着对比了上一讲的自回归模型：自回归模型在很多方面表现不错，但有三个不足——采样是串行的（因此很慢）、缺乏隐空间表示、而且主要在离散数据上取得成功。

environment: Claude streams Section 2: '二、基础回顾：概率密度模型', explaining continuous data density modeling via MLE minimization of E_x[-log p_θ(x)], and analyzing why Mixture of Gaussians essentially memorizes training data when generating high-dimensional images.
text_visible: 二、基础回顾：概率密度模型
讲义从最基本的问题出发：如何拟合一个连续数据的密度模型？
给定一批连续数据点，通过最大似然估计来训练，即最小化E_x[-logp_θ(x)]。
举了高斯混合模型(Mixture of Gaussians)的例子：参数包括每个组分的均值、方差和混合权重。但讲义指出，高斯混合模型在高维数据（如自然图像）上效果很差，因为其采样过程本质上是“选一个聚类中心+加高斯噪声”，要生成逼真图像，聚类中心本身就必须是逼真图像，相当于直接记忆了训练数据。
details: My gaze follows the formula and the explanation of GMM cluster centers memorizing image data.

第一层 p(x) 展示原始分布的概率密度。点击「采样并变换」后，橙色的采样点会堆积在密度高的区域
第二层 F_X(x) 是关键的变换环节。每个样本点 x 沿虚线向上投射到 CDF 曲线上，再水平投射到左侧的 u 轴。核心直觉在于：密度高的地方 CDF 上升陡峭，大量样本被“挤压”到一小段 u 区间；密度低的地方 CDF 平缓，少量样本被“拉伸”到同样宽度的 u 区间。这一压一拉恰好抵消了原始密度的不均匀。
第三层 p(u) 展示变换后 u = F_X(x) 的直方图。无论原始分布是什么形状，直方图都会趋近于红色虚线标出的理想均匀分布。
你可以试试切换不同的分布类型（双峰、偏态、指数），或者点「逐步动画」

environment: a) PHYSICAL SPACE: An indoor university building corridor transitioning into an elevator lobby. Overhead fluorescent light panels are set into a white acoustic tile drop ceiling. The corridor floor is covered in dark grey linear-patterned carpet, while the elevator lobby floor consists of polished light beige square ceramic tiles. Walls are painted off-white with vertical reddish-brown wood-textured cladding surrounding the elevator shafts. No other people are present. b) OBJECTS: In my right hand is an iPhone in a pinkish-beige protective case; wearing light grey trousers and dark athletic shoes. To the left is a freestanding metal sign stand with an informational placard. Ahead is an elevator bank with two elevator shafts separated by a brown column featuring a floor indicator, a call button panel with illuminated red LEDs, a framed white directory sign, and a cylindrical stainless steel trash/ash receptacle at its base. In the far background, a water dispenser, double grey louvered doors, a green emergency exit sign, an overhead restroom directional sign, a framed landscape painting, and a blue cushioned bench along the far wall are visible. c) SCREEN CONTENT: iPhone screen is lit with a white-background list/feed interface. d) TEXT IN THE WORLD: Metal numeral '1' mounted on the elevator column; green emergency exit sign on the right corner wall; directional restroom signage in the distance. e) MEDIA BEING PLAYED: None. f) AMBIENT AUDIO: Quiet building ventilation ambiance.
details: I look down at my phone screen in my right hand as I utter '嗯。' while walking along the carpeted corridor.
